payment_nested.query: select count(p.id) from payments p where p.booking_id in(select b.id from bookings b where b.id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid))

payment_direct.query: select count(p.id) from payments p where p.booking_id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)

booking_direct.query: select count(b.id) from bookings b where b.id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)
